opportunities.name: Trip planning: flights, hotel, activity, then summary note
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search Google Flights, Booking.com hotels and Viator tours, then save a trip summary note with prices.
steps: Google Flights: set origin Paris, enter destination, pick departure and return dates, Done, Search
Booking.com: dismiss popups, enter destination, select dates, Search, open top hotel and note name and price
Viator: search '<attraction> tour <city>', open top result, note title and price
Open notes app, create new note 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., tour...' and press Enter

instances.values: Rome, Dec 3-7 2026, Colosseum tour, note saved
Barcelona, Jan 20-24 2027, Sagrada Familia tour, note saved

opportunities.name: PyPI library comparison note
opportunities.description: Look up two Python packages on PyPI, visit each repository for stars, and save a comparison note with version, date, stars and license.
steps: Search PyPI for package A, open its page, note version, date, license
Click Repository link and note GitHub stars
Create note '<A> version date stars license vs <B> ...' and press Enter

opportunities.description: Check a web feature's browser support on caniuse and MDN, then draft an email to a person with the version and MDN docs link.
steps: Search feature on caniuse and read support version
Search the feature on MDN and open the docs page
Open mail compose, fill To, Subject 'Re: <feature> in <browser>'
Type body with name, supported version and MDN URL
